name: Houdini MCP: Scene Context
description: Aggregates the active Houdini session's state into one structured payload suitable for AI agents and LLM prompts. Shape-stable: every key is always present even when empty. Sections (scene / selection / networks / assets / render) can be toggled individually. Cached for 5s; force_refresh bypasses the cache.
python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime import houdini_runtime

class HouMCPSceneContextNode(BaseNode):
    name = "Houdini MCP: Scene Context"
    category = "Houdini"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.icon_path = "icons/houdini_icon.png"
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("include_selection", "bool", widget_type="bool", default=True)
        self.add_input("include_assets", "bool", widget_type="bool", default=True)
        self.add_input("include_render", "bool", widget_type="bool", default=True)
        self.add_input("force_refresh", "bool", widget_type="bool", default=False)
        self.add_output("context", "any")
        self.add_output("context_json", "string")
        self.add_output("scene", "any")
        self.add_output("networks", "any")
        self.add_output("selection", "list")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        try:
            context = await houdini_runtime.scene_context(
                include_selection=bool(inputs.get("include_selection", True)),
                include_assets=bool(inputs.get("include_assets", True)),
                include_render=bool(inputs.get("include_render", True)),
                force_refresh=bool(inputs.get("force_refresh", False)),
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"scene_context failed: {exc}")
            return {
                "context": {},
                "context_json": "",
                "scene": {},
                "networks": {},
                "selection": [],
                "exec_out": True,
            }

        prompt_json = houdini_runtime.context_to_prompt(context)
        self.log_info(
            f"Scene context: {len(context.get('selection') or [])} selected, "
            f"{len(context.get('networks') or {})} networks summarised."
        )
        return {
            "context": context,
            "context_json": prompt_json,
            "scene": context.get("scene") or {},
            "networks": context.get("networks") or {},
            "selection": context.get("selection") or [],
            "exec_out": True,
        }

def register_node():
    return HouMCPSceneContextNode
